item.title: [ECG] Invitation to Advisory's Events - Discover+ Events Management 2026
item.description: Dear Students, iYou are invited to join us at Advisory’s upcoming event, Discover+: Events Management. Discover+: Events Management Date: 26 May 2026 Tuesday | Time: 7:30pm to 9:00pm Registration Deadline: 26 May 2026, Tuesday | Time: 7:00pm (GMT+8) EVENTS MANAGEMENT | Singapore has firmly established itself as Asia’s premier events and entertainment hub, hosting world-class events like Formula 1 Grand Prix as well as other major international concerts. Beyond entertainment, Singapore is also a global leader in the Meetings, Incentives, Conferences and Exhibitions (MICE) sector, ranking as the top city in Asia-Pacific for meetings and third city globally (ICCA, 2024). With Singapore’s position as a trusted destination for entertainment and international business events, the demand for large-scale, experiential, and hybrid events is only expected to grow. Alongside, there too would be a rising need for professionals responsible for planning, coordinating, and delivering these events concept to execution. Despite the industry’s prominence, many students may have limited awareness of the diverse career pathways within event management and lack exposure to the skills required to enter this field. Therefore, Advisory hopes to connect students with an interest in such work with professionals in the field through Discover+: Events Management. Register at https://bit.ly/Discov er-EventsManagement2026 by 26th May 2026, 7pm. Have a great week ahead! Thank you Kind Regards Ms Khadija A Senior Education and Career Guidance Counsellor
